title: AG60101: Watershed Management
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Definitions: watershed, watershed classification, watershed delineation,
Watershed resources inventory and identification of problems
People participation in watershed management, National programmes on watershed
management
Quantification of watershed response (runoff and sediment yield),
instrumentation and methods for measurement of sediment, estimation of sediment
loss, watershed prioritization
Soil conservation measures biological and Mechanical measures, gully control
structures, earthen dam, water harvesting structures, river training structures
and gabians
Planning and operation of watershed management projects
Watershed models
